title: DexHandDiff: Interaction-aware Diffusion Planning for Adaptive Dexterous Manipulation
authors: Zhixuan Liang, Yao Mu, Yixiao Wang, Tianxing Chen, Wenqi Shao, Wei Zhan, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Ping Luo, Mingyu Ding

tldr.zh: DexHandDiff 为灵巧手扩散规划设计交互感知引导：接触前引导手对齐交互点，接触后联合目标与动力学约束调整状态—动作轨迹，通过修改采样引导适配示范之外的操作目标。
tldr.en: DexHandDiff designs interaction-aware guidance for dexterous diffusion planning: align the hand with an interaction point before contact, then guide state–action trajectories with goal and dynamics constraints, adapting to goals beyond the demonstrations by changing sampling guidance.

evaluation_scope.zh: 从示范逐任务训练联合状态—动作扩散模型及独立动力学模型；目标适配主要在去噪采样中调整引导，不为每个新目标重训策略。开门／用锤等按手掌与交互点距离切换对齐和目标引导；手内操作使用目标、手指运动和动力学等单阶段引导。状态—动作一致性约束减少物体无接触自行移动的 ghost states；动作分量用于执行并滚动重规划。LLM 根据环境说明生成引导函数代码，主要成绩使用人工引导。仿真覆盖 Adroit／Shadow Hand 的开门、转笔、锤钉、搬移、方块转向，未报告真机验证。仅 90° 开门示范训练后，六种开／关门目标均值为 59.2%（引导采样 Diffuser 为 29.5%）；四种开门角度消融中，联合建模＋动力学引导为 31.7%，完整交互机制为 67.5%，不是全任务均值。官方公开部分实现及 Adroit Door 预训练权重；首次预印本于 2024-11-27 公开，条目按 CVPR 2025／v6 阅读。
evaluation_scope.en: Task-specific joint state–action diffusion and separate dynamics models are learned from demonstrations. New goals primarily change denoising guidance without per-goal policy retraining. Door/tool tasks switch alignment and goal guidance using palm-to-interaction-point distance; in-hand tasks use single-phase goal, finger-motion and dynamics guidance. Consistency constraints reduce ghost object motion; generated actions execute with receding-horizon replanning. An LLM generates guidance code from environment descriptions; main scores use handcrafted guidance. Adroit/Shadow Hand simulation covers door, pen, hammer, relocation and block tasks, without reported hardware validation. Training only on 90° opening yields 59.2% across six opening/closing goals versus 29.5% for guided Diffuser. On four door angles, joint modeling plus dynamics guidance scores 31.7%, versus 67.5% for the complete interaction mechanism; these are not all-task means. Official resources provide partial implementation and an Adroit Door checkpoint. The first preprint appeared on 2024-11-27; this entry follows CVPR 2025/v6.
